item.title: Aoi Sora no Camus
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: KAI
  • 発売日: 2019-03-29
  • スコア: 7.43/10 (359 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 青い空のカミュ
  • 英語名: Aoi Sora no Camus

别名

  • BSC

あらすじ

Rin and Hotaru were friends who attended the same school located in a river valley. After shopping in town, they boarded a train to go home but overslept. When Rin woke up, they were already at the last stop, the village where Hotaru lived. Since she had missed her stop considerably, she decided to stay over at Hotaru’s place for the night. However, she soon noticed that something was amiss. Even though it was only 8pm, there was no one else around…

item.title: Majo to Tsurugi to Sen no Tsuki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: KAI
  • 発売日: 2017-04-28
  • スコア: 7.1/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔女と剣と千の月
  • 英語名: Majo to Tsurugi to Sen no Tsuki

あらすじ

This game takes place after the events of PENDULUM. Peace seemed to have been returned to the world with the decrease in the remaining number of circulars. However, one day the pure white circulars suddenly turned into pitch-black demons who have a increased penchant for destruction. These ‘evilised’ spread all over the world in an instant. The Magus Order continued to fight on the front line, but they were being overwhelmed by the power of the evilised.

item.title: PENDULUM
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: KAI
  • 発売日: 2015-06-26
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (38 人評価)
  • 日本語名: PENDULUM
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

PENDULUM takes place after the events of KAI’s debut title Walpurgis. It had been four years since the abominable ‘Circle of Doom’ incident and true peace still had not fully returned to the world. Various areas were still infested with grotesque angels (circulars) and it was up to a group of girls with magical powers, Magus Order, to rid them once and for all.

item.title: Blade's Heart
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: KAI
  • 発売日: 2011-07-29
  • スコア: 6.74/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ブレイズハート
  • 英語名: Blade’s Heart

あらすじ

There is something strange happening in the town and the school. People would mysteriously disappear for days only to suddenly appear again. The school hallways would seem to go on forever, but then all would be normal again. It was as if there are two separate worlds which were intertwined together. One day, Ryouji noticed a girl that he hadn’t seen before, but everyone else did not seem to be surprised at all and treated her like she had always been a student at the school. The girl Ouka approached him and said: “You’ve noticed, right? Which side are you on?”

item.title: Walpurgis
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: KAI
  • 発売日: 2010-09-24
  • スコア: 6.43/10 (32 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ヴァルプルギス
  • 英語名: Walpurgis

あらすじ

One winter day, some humans suddenly turned into monsters that massacred those around them. With glowing wings and halos on their head, they looked like angels rather than monsters. The sight of angels slaughtering humans is surely a sign of the impending end of the world. No one knows what their purpose is, and a school was built to train students to be mahou senshi fighting against these angels – ‘the four halos’. Ren looks like a normal student, but he actually has a magic bloodline and was scouted to be a teacher at this school.
